evidence.reason: The test named `test_prepare_stays_inert_verifies_before_install...` never asserts that `systemd-analyze` was invoked, nor that it received the expected rendered unit paths. Lines 49-51 only validate paths if the verifier branch happens to run, and `all(...)` is vacuously true with no paths. Lines 62-63 assert only daemon-reload and absence of start/enable. Therefore `prepare` could skip verification entirely and still pass, leaving the intended verify-before-install behavior unprotected. This is a minor test defect, not a new requirement.
